status.title: Status
status.tip: Each step keeps its date and who made it. Sign: download the PDF, sign it and upload the scan.
status.sendTip: Freezes this revision's agreement and annexes; the customer then uploads the signed scan.
status.newRevisionTip: Back to draft as a new revision: the terms may change and both sides sign again.

files.title: Agreement and annexes
files.tip: Every upload is a new version; the earlier ones are kept.

kind.annex_a: Annex A: product, guaranteed values, test conditions

annexATip: Annex A will be generated from the project's guaranteed values; until then it is uploaded.

company.filledTip: Annex B takes the customer company from the Company details form.
company.missingTip: The customer fills in the Company details form; Annex B takes the company from it.
company.notYetTip: The Company details form is not available yet.

terms.title: Standard terms
terms.tip: The standard agreement is the same for every customer.
terms.samples: Samples are test units without warranty; a guaranteed value a sample misses is taken into account in the next iteration.
terms.series: Series: 12 months warranty from DAP delivery, after at least two sample iterations with full testing.
terms.dispatch: Dispatch within two months of receipt of the payment.
terms.supply: Supply from China directly to the customer.
terms.law: Law of Slovenia; courts in Ljubljana.

pickFile: Choose a file (PDF, DOCX, PNG, JPG)
frozenTip: The signing of this revision rests on this file: it cannot be replaced or archived. Start a new revision to change the terms.
